name: apiverket-mcp
description: Query Swedish public data through Apiverket with endpoint discovery, family workflow playbooks, structured recovery guidance, and account limit context.
long_description: Apiverket MCP gives AI agents three read-only tools for Swedish public data: govdata_discover to find supported endpoints and recommended family workflows, govdata_query to call endpoints with structured recovery guidance, and govdata_account to inspect sanitized tier and quota context. It includes playbooks for companies, transport, weather, geography, municipalities, jobs, government, culture, education, tourism, and environment so agents can search/list/detail correctly and avoid unsupported path guesses.

tools.name: govdata_discover
tools.description: Search and browse available Apiverket endpoints with recommended family workflows

tools.name: govdata_query
tools.description: Call a selected Apiverket endpoint and return structured JSON

tools.name: govdata_account
tools.description: Inspect sanitized account tier, usage, and quota limits for the configured API key
